blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A chemistry graduate from the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) and a Mindoro native has secured sixth place in the October 2026 Chemists Computer-Based Licensure Examination with a rating of 93.50 percent. The CALABCO community recognized John Dominic T. Romasanta, a former member, for his achievement in the licensure exams. CALABCO stands for CALSEDECO Laboratory Cooperative, a youth-oriented cooperative organized under the Calapan Labor Service Development Cooperative (CALSEDECO) in Oriental Mindoro. In a congratulatory message, CALABCO praised Romasanta’s hard work, perseverance, and commitment to excellence, saying his performance had brought pride to his family, […]...
